title: About
paragraphs: Okem Precious is a passionate brand identity designer, videographer, and creative visionary who brings ideas to life through meaningful visual storytelling.
He is the founder of XplicitDesign, a creative brand built on the belief that great design does more than look good — it connects, inspires, and transforms how people experience brands.

With a keen eye for detail and a deep understanding of visual communication, Precious creates designs that capture emotion and purpose. His work reflects a commitment to helping businesses and individuals express their identity with clarity, confidence, and creativity in a visually driven world.
